message.content:
This is a **working admin calendar page** (not an error page).  

### Visible UI Elements:  
- Header: “Glow Admin” (with a menu icon), “Calendar” title, and a subtitle about dragging appointments.  
- Filter/View Controls: “All services” dropdown, “Today”/date range (“Jun 29 – Jul 5, 2026”), and view toggles (Day/Week/Month).  
- Status Tabs: “Available slot,” “Booked,” “Completed,” and “Blocked / Holiday” legend.  
- Calendar Grid: A weekly calendar (Mon 29–Sun 5) with time slots (9:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 3:00 PM, 5:00 PM) for each day. Slots show statuses (e.g., “Available,” “Blocked,” or “Booked” with customer/service details like “Sophia Wilson - Full Leg Laser Waxing”).  
- Day Headers: Labeled days (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun) with dates.
